metaTitle: Persistent Setbacks and Sheng Ji: Practical Steps and Service Limits
metaDescription: Facing repeated setbacks? Review financial and personal risks first. Sheng Ji is a cultural service with no guaranteed reversal of losses or fixed response time.

h1: Persistent setbacks: address the real problem before buying a ritual
heroSub: No guaranteed reversal of losses · Check the full RMB cost and written terms

sections.h2: Identify what is actually going wrong

items.h3: Separate events from a single “bad luck” story
items.content: Repeated losses can have different causes: cash flow, counterparties, health, work or family circumstances. List the facts and seek relevant professional help where needed.
Claims that a ritual must be purchased immediately to prevent harm can pressure people who are already struggling. Take time to compare options and decide within a budget you can afford.

items.h3: Traditional meaning is not an outcome promise
items.content: Practitioners may describe cleansing or date selection as part of the ceremony. Those are cultural interpretations, not evidence that future losses will reverse or that a response will occur within a year.
Before paying, verify the provider, practitioner, location, materials, privacy, recording, returned items, RMB total, RMB 10,000 deposit, remaining balance, refund and rescheduling terms.
Continue medical care, debt management, legal advice, business analysis or family support as applicable. A cultural service cannot replace these steps.
